text: CI routing is built but inert: docs/design/ci-routing.md section 10 says the candidate commit is never pushed, so routing finds no CI result and every check still runs locally (a one-line config job still took 29 minutes). Wire section 5.2 steps 1-3 and 5: after the producer finishes, push the candidate commit so CI runs on it, wait for CI's run on that exact SHA within a bounded time, and have the checks step reuse that result, with the local fallback already built. The verifier's reuse is a separate request.
